name: branding-geometric-bird-symbol-with-device-applications
title: Solid geometric bird symbol on laptop and smartwatch
whatItIs: A white slide with a large solid black bird symbol whose body is a star, then two photographic applications: a laptop in hard sunlight on green stone showing the mark and name, and a smartwatch on a wrist showing the bird in white on black.
whatItMeans: Bold, swift and precise; the simple silhouette works at watch-face size.
techniques: Reduce an animal to a few geometric planes (wings and a star body).
Test the symbol on tiny screens such as a watch.
Photograph mockups with dramatic hard shadows.
Keep the presentation black-and-white with small caption text.
bestFor: Symbols that must work at very small sizes

vocabulary.definition: A solid-colour symbol defined by its outline.
Simplifying a form into basic shapes.
Showing a logo at tiny scale.
A photo with strong sunlight shadows.
